verdicts: VERDICT: p08:S2 Proposition 1 (expression and sign) CONFIRMED
VERDICT: p08:fnd:8 DEMONSTRATED: with u measured as a z-score, H(u) <= 0 is possible (u <= -h0/h1) and the buy rule reverses; k* undefined at m = 1

VERDICT: p08:fnd:1 DEMONSTRATED: Appendix omits -(s+G)h1/(H^2(1-m)^2); true cross-partial = (g1*h0 - h1*(s+g0))/(H^2(1-m)^2); A3 <=> numerator < 0, so Prop. 2 is false at every admissible (m,u) under A3
VERDICT: p08:inc:2 DEMONSTRATED: Prop. 2 holds iff A3 fails iff dk*/du > 0 (uncertainty favours the market)
VERDICT: p08:fnd:2 DEMONSTRATED (k* scale): the correctly derived model under A3 predicts a NEGATIVE m x u interaction (same sign as ms:T2.M3, -0.061) and dk*/du < 0
VERDICT: p08:fnd:3 DEMONSTRATED: modularity's per-function cost saving rises with u (h1*k > 0), but its threshold effect is k*/(1-m), which falls with u under A3

VERDICT: p08:fnd:4 DEMONSTRATED: under A3 the k*-scale interaction is negative, but the Phi-scale interaction has sign sign(Delta)*sign(f + k f'), positive for beta(1,5) at k* = 0.4; the step from Prop. 2 to H2 needs an assumption on F
VERDICT: p08:S2 (H1 part) CONFIRMED: dPhi/dm = f(k*) k*/(1-m) >= 0 for every spending-weighted F; H1 follows from Prop. 1 without further assumption
VERDICT: p08:fnd:6 DEMONSTRATED: stars inconsistent with coefficient/SE for T2.M3.uncertainty
VERDICT: p08:fnd:7 DEMONSTRATED: N = 4,712 is incompatible with a balanced panel of 412 hospitals over 2009-2019 (4,532; 4,120 with lag)
VERDICT: p08:S3 CONFIRMED: 2.7 pp, ~1/6 SD, >2/3 drop correct; all other stars consistent

VERDICT: p08:fnd:5 DEMONSTRATED (tension, not refutation): under A3 the model implies dPhi/du <= 0 at every m; Table 2 point estimates of dPhi/du are positive for all m in [0,1] (M3, M4); none is significant at 5% under any cov(b2,b3) (max |z| = 1.65); the manuscript neither states nor tests the implication
